players.csv: Django Player master data, one row per squad member.
matches.csv: Django Match rows for the 12 double round-robin fixtures.
innings.csv: Django Innings rows, two innings per match.
ball_events.csv: Django BallEvent rows with legal/illegal delivery handling and shot metadata.
live_infographic_cards.csv: Django LiveInfographicCard rows with JSON payload fields serialized as strings.
player_attributes.csv: Synthetic skill ratings used for simulation and ML features.
lineups.csv: Playing XI and batting order per innings.
player_match_features.csv: Model training data for player-level predictions.
ball_training_features.csv: Model training data for ball-level predictions.
